title: Bloodlust Netherite
description: Makes all netherite in the main game red
body:
Made for my minecraft server with friends but yall can use it.
It makes all minecraft netherite textures a bit red.
Fun to use but fair warning!
It makes it look  a bit like copper or redstone.

Made by NLPainkiller/Susylako
